name: 21K School
classes: Nursery-12 (Indian pathway); Early Years to A Level (British pathway)
format: Live classes, up to 24 learners per class (class of 16, 20 or 24 chosen); recorded classes not mentioned; facilitator ratio not stated
timings: Indian pathway Grades 1-5: live slots at 9:30 AM, 11:00 AM, 1:30 PM or 3:20 PM IST; about 3 hours of live class a day; Monday to Friday
timings_note: Counsellor confirms each child's slot. Early primary live sessions are shorter, about 1.5 to 2 hours.

curriculum.summary: The Indian pathway is aligned to the National Curriculum Framework 2023, with NIOS for senior grades. The British pathway uses Cambridge Primary and Lower Secondary, then IGCSE or A Level, or Pearson Edexcel IAL.

fees_note: Indian pathway Grades 1-5, annual fee before rebates: Rs 98,800 (Grade 1) to Rs 1,07,500 (Grade 5), for a class of 20 (2027 intake). Registration, board fees and trips are extra. Rs 5,000 off for paying annually; sibling rebate Rs 5,000.
how_to_check: Admissions page (apply.21kschool.com) and the Indian-pathway fee breakdown; fee breakdown seen only for Grade 1.
gaps: fee breakdown for Grades 2-5 (only the total is listed)
